title: air vent deflectors
text: air vent deflectors. I love these. I have wider vents on my floor... these are meant to be used on wall vents, but they work perfectly on my wider floor vents. My vent tops are metal so the magnets work well. They are clear... and a thick plastic.  They seem sturdy.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Deflecto Air Deflector for Sidewall Register, Adjustable from 10” to 16” Wide, Clear (51)
features: Tired of wall vents blasting cold or hot air straight to your face? Our Air Deflector for Wall Register effectively redirects forced air to deliver more consistent coverage around the home
Upgrade your Do It Yourself game to Pro It Yourself; Easily attach this air deflector to the register using the included metal magnets or the molded-in screw slots
The deflector’s width can be adjusted between 10” to 16” to achieve the ideal fit for registers of any size
Works for both central air heating and cooling applications; Pair this with our Floor Register for optimal air flow and energy efficiency
This flexible air deflector is made from lightweight clear plastic for easy handling and installation
description: Ever felt hot in one corner of the room and cold in another? Our Air Deflector for Wall Register effectively redirects the forced air that comes out of your vents to ensure more consistent coverage around the home and save energy. You don't need a professional to install this deflector; Simply attach it to the register using the attached strong metal magnets, or if your vent is not made of metal, the molded-in screw slots. The deflector’s width can be adjusted between 10” to 16” to achieve the ideal fit for registers of any size. Suitable for both central air heating and cooling applications; Pair with our Floor Register for optimal air flow and even better energy efficiency. This flexible air deflector is made from lightweight clear plastic for easy handling and installation.
